title: Related-Key Differential Search Beyond Byte-Oriented Components
summary: Existing automated search is byte-oriented; supporting small non-byte-oriented cipher components, including Camellia's key-schedule rotations, remains open.

formal_statement.body: Develop a method for the related-key differential-characteristic search tool for byte-oriented block ciphers to handle ciphers containing small non-byte-oriented components, with Camellia's key-schedule rotations as a specific case that the method must support.

scope.domain: Automated related-key differential cryptanalysis of byte-oriented block ciphers with small non-byte-oriented components, including Camellia key-schedule rotations.
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop a method that enables the search tool to handle small non-byte-oriented components, including Camellia's key-schedule rotations.

citations.label: Automatic Search for Related-Key Differential Characteristics in Byte-Oriented Block Ciphers: Application to AES, Camellia, Khazad and Others

progress.summary: The source presents this as the first open problem arising from implementation of the tool and identifies Camellia's key-schedule rotations as the motivating unsupported case.
citation_labels: Alex Biryukov et al., Automatic Search for Related-Key Differential Characteristics in Byte-Oriented Block Ciphers: Application to AES, Camellia, Khazad and Others
